Package renderer

Class ShadowTests

java.lang.Object
renderer.ShadowTests
class ShadowTests extends Object
Testing basic shadows in a 3D rendering environment. These tests verify the correct implementation of shadow casting from light sources.

  • Method Details

    • sphereTriangleHelper

      private void sphereTriangleHelper(String pictName, Triangle triangle, Point spotLocation)
      Helper function for the shadow tests involving a sphere and a triangle. This method sets up the scene with the predefined sphere and a given triangle, adds a spotlight at a specified location, and then renders and saves the image.
      Parameters:
      pictName - The name of the picture file to be generated by the test.
      triangle - The Triangle object to be added to the scene. Its emission color is set to blue and its material is set to trMaterial.
      spotLocation - The Point representing the location of the SpotLight in the scene.

    • sphereTriangleMove1

      @Test void sphereTriangleMove1()
      Produces a picture of a sphere and a triangle, illuminated by a point light, demonstrating a specific shadow configuration by moving the triangle. The triangle is placed slightly behind the sphere relative to the light source.

    • sphereTriangleMove2

      @Test void sphereTriangleMove2()
      Produces a picture of a sphere and a triangle, illuminated by a point light, demonstrating another shadow configuration by moving the triangle. The triangle is placed differently behind the sphere to show a varied shadow.

    • sphereTriangleSpot1

      @Test void sphereTriangleSpot1()
      Produces a picture of a sphere and a triangle, illuminated by a spot light, demonstrating a specific shadow configuration with the spotlight in a particular position. The triangle's position creates a shadow from the sphere.

    • sphereTriangleSpot2

      @Test void sphereTriangleSpot2()
      Produces a picture of a sphere and a triangle, illuminated by a spot light, demonstrating another shadow configuration with the spotlight moved closer. This test shows the effect of changing the spotlight's position on the shadow.

    • trianglesSphere

      @Test void trianglesSphere()
      Produces a picture of two triangles lighted by a spot light with a Sphere producing a shading effect. This test demonstrates how a sphere can cast shadows onto other geometries in the scene.
